Policy Name: Cigna ACDF (CMM-601: Anterior Cervical Discectomy and Fusion)
Referred Sections: CMM-601.6: Repeat Anterior Cervical Discectomy and Fusion (ACDF) at the Same Level
Malposition or Failure of Implant/Instrumentation or Structural Bone Graft

Medical necessity indications.Guideline Category: Malposition or Failure of Implant/Instrumentation or Structural Bone Graft
Required findings: Post‑operative imaging (X‑ray, CT, or MRI) demonstrates malposition, migration, breakage, loosening, loss of curve correction, or other hardware failure at the previously fused level
Findings are directly related to the patient's current symptoms
No requirement for conservative therapy trial because hardware failure is an anatomic indication
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-601.6 > Malposition or Failure of Implant/Instrumentation or Structural Bone Graft

Required findings: ≥6 months elapsed since the prior ACDF at the same level
Daily neck pain causing clinically significant functional impairment (e.g., inability to perform household chores, prolonged standing)
Physical examination findings concordant with pain (e.g., localized tenderness, limited range of motion) but no neurologic deficit required
Post‑operative imaging performed ≥6 months after the prior fusion shows pseudoarthrosis at the index level
MRI/CT demonstrates findings concordant with symptoms (e.g., lack of fusion, motion‑related changes)

Failure to achieve meaningful improvement after BOTH of the following for ≥6 weeks (unless contraindicated): prescription‑strength analgesics/NSAIDs/steroids/gabapentinoids and a provider‑directed exercise program
Absence of unmanaged significant mental/behavioral health disorder
Documented nicotine‑free status: either never‑smoker or ≥6 weeks abstinence verified by objective cotinine test (serum, urine, or saliva) within normal range
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-601.6 > Unremitting Neck Pain with Pseudoarthrosis

Required findings: ≥6 months elapsed since the prior ACDF at the same level
Daily pain with functional impairment PLUS unremitting radicular pain to shoulder girdle or upper extremity causing disability
Physical exam showing any of: dermatomal sensory loss, motor weakness (biceps/triceps), reflex changes, positive Spurling’s maneuver, shoulder abduction relief sign, or nerve‑root tension sign
Post‑operative imaging ≥6 months after prior fusion shows pseudoarthrosis at the index level
MRI/CT demonstrates neural structure compression at the same level that correlates with symptoms and exam (e.g., disc herniation, cyst, stenosis, osteophyte)

Failure to achieve meaningful improvement after at least TWO of the following for ≥6 weeks (unless contraindicated): prescription‑strength analgesics/NSAIDs/steroids/gabapentinoids, provider‑directed exercise program, epidural steroid injection or selective nerve‑root block at the same level
Absence of unmanaged significant mental/behavioral health disorder
Documented nicotine‑free status as defined above
≥6 months elapsed since the prior ACDF at the same level
Symptoms of myelopathy: upper/lower extremity weakness, numbness, pain, fine motor dysfunction, gait disturbance, new bowel/bladder dysfunction, or frequent falls

Physical exam demonstrating any myelopathic sign: grip‑and‑release weakness, ataxic gait, hyperreflexia, Hoffmann sign, Babinski sign, tandem walking ataxia, inverted brachial radial reflex, increased tone/spasticity, clonus, myelopathic hand
Post‑operative imaging ≥6 months after prior fusion shows pseudoarthrosis at the index level
MRI/CT shows cervical spinal cord compression or stenosis at the same level that explains the clinical findings
Absence of unmanaged significant mental/behavioral health disorder
Documented nicotine‑free status as defined above

Non-Indications: Less than six months since the prior ACDF at the same level
Absence of documented pseudoarthrosis on imaging for pain, radiculopathy, or myelopathy indications
Pain or radicular symptoms without functional impairment or without concordant objective exam findings

Failure to complete the required minimum six‑week trial of conservative therapy (analgesics/NSAIDs/steroids/gabapentinoids and exercise program) when required, unless a documented contraindication exists
Active tobacco use without verified six‑week abstinence or without objective cotinine testing within normal limits
Unmanaged significant mental or behavioral health disorders (e.g., major depressive disorder, chronic pain syndrome, opioid use disorder, secondary gain)
Imaging that does not demonstrate hardware malposition/failure or pseudoarthrosis at the index level
Important criteria & exceptions: Nicotine‑free verification may be satisfied by either self‑reported never‑smoker status or objective cotinine testing (serum, urine, or saliva) performed within the appropriate laboratory reference range; testing must be within six weeks prior to the planned surgery
Conservative therapy trial may be waived only if the patient has a documented contraindication to analgesics, steroids, gabapentinoids, NSAIDs, or to a structured exercise program

For radiculopathy, improvement must be lacking after at least two of the three conservative modalities (medication, exercise, epidural steroid or selective nerve‑root block); for neck pain, both medication and exercise must have been tried
Behavioral health assessment must document that no significant unmanaged psychiatric or substance‑use disorder is present at the time of request
Documentation required: Operative report of the prior ACDF including level(s) fused
Post‑operative plain cervical spine flexion/extension X‑rays, CT, or MRI performed ≥6 months after the prior fusion showing pseudoarthrosis or hardware failure
Radiology report interpreting the imaging and specifically commenting on pseudoarthrosis, hardware position, and any neural compression
Comprehensive clinical note documenting daily pain severity, functional limitation, and any neurologic deficits (sensory, motor, reflex, myelopathic signs)
Physical therapy or chiropractic progress notes confirming ≥6 weeks of a provider‑directed exercise program
Pharmacy records or provider notes confirming ≥6 weeks of prescription‑strength analgesics/NSAIDs/steroids/gabapentinoids (or documentation of contraindication)
Epidural steroid injection or selective nerve‑root block procedure reports (if used for radiculopathy indication)
Objective cotinine test result (serum, urine, or saliva) performed within six weeks of the surgery request, with values within normal range
Behavioral health evaluation note confirming absence of unmanaged significant mental or substance‑use disorder
Smoking history documentation confirming never‑smoker status or cessation date
